profile.name: John David Gulifardo
profile.role: Full-Stack Engineer · Enterprise ERP & Edge Systems
profile.bio: Bridging the gap between physical hardware and legacy systems on one side and modern web architectures on the other — custom desktop daemons, real-time sync engines, and enterprise SaaS. I architect production systems end-to-end: from TALL-stack web ERPs and multi-tenant payroll platforms to offline-first POS terminals, biometric time-attendance hardware, and self-updating Windows agents that keep branch offices running without technicians.
highlights: Designs production systems end-to-end, not just features
Connects proprietary hardware & legacy DBF/MySQL systems to modern web platforms
BIR-compliant finance, payroll, and POS tooling for the Philippine market
Ships compiled, self-healing desktop agents and installers to real branch offices
profile.tagline: Hardware meets the web. Legacy meets real-time. Built to ship.

featured.title: APCHub (APCInventory)
featured.subtitle: Enterprise Integrated Business Systems for a Multi-Branch Financial Institution
featured.pitch: A monolithic Laravel ERP that centralizes corporate operations, financial services, field marketing, HR, biometric timekeeping, and hardware infrastructure — engineered as three interlocking systems: a TALL-stack web backend, compiled Python biometric desktop tools, and legacy-data reconciliation & automation.
features: Scale that speaks for itself — 233 migrations, ~119 Eloquent models, ~93 Livewire components, 63 controllers, 32 artisan commands, 296 Blade views.
Custom RBAC built on role/permission pivots with a recursive manager→subordinate tree, hierarchy-scoped Kanban board, and ~90 permission slugs for per-button visibility — not a package drop-in.
Real-time everywhere: private chat with presence, read receipts & reactions, live biometric device telemetry, and a live passbook-release collection index over Pusher/Reverb + Echo.
Hardened middleware stack — global activity audit logger, session fingerprinting, forced password rotation, custom 2FA, security headers, and AJAX-aware auth redirects.
Universal biometric bridge: one SmartDeviceAdapter for ZKTeco AND NGTeco, write-verify loops, 100-worker subnet discovery, and a single-instance daemon that self-updates its own binary.

Automation & migration — Flask delta-sync server mirrored to S3, legacy MySQL/DBF pension migration with per-row fault isolation, CSV import pipelines with heuristic column repair, and scheduled billing/reminder jobs.

featured.title: M2P POS
featured.subtitle: Offline-First Point-of-Sale, Inventory & BIR-Compliance System
featured.pitch: A complete offline-first POS + inventory + financials system for a school-supplies wholesale/retail business. Runs on one PC or a small LAN with a permission-gated JSON-RPC server fronting PostgreSQL — no internet required, ever.
features: 167 RPC methods registered in a single ROUTES map as source of truth — access decided by exact permission-set membership, per-user permissions overriding roles.
Money stored in integer centavos (never floats), an immutable stock-moves ledger, and a full audit log on every create/update/delete/status change.
BIR-ready out of the box — official receipts, annual grand-total accumulation, eJournal & eSales exports, VAT reconciliation, X/Z readings, and a reprint audit trail.
Dual-mode gateway: direct PostgreSQL on one PC, or a permission-enforced JSON-RPC LAN server for multi-workstation deployment — all 20 bir.* routes regression-tested end-to-end.
Production packaging: three Windows installers including a server bundle with self-contained PostgreSQL and NSSM services, plus a kiosk register build.
Keyboard-driven checkout (F1–F12), SC/PWD discounts, post-dated cheque monitor with calendar, AP/AR workflows, and supplier receivable contracts.

featured.title: Payroll & HR Management SaaS
featured.subtitle: Multi-Tenant Philippine Payroll Platform with Biometric Reconciliation
featured.pitch: A multi-tenant payroll & HR SaaS for the Philippine market: automated weekly payroll with statutory 13th-month, cash-advance ledgers, biometric timekeeping reconciliation, and immutable locked payslips — plus one-click Windows compilers that self-host the entire stack on client machines.
features: Payroll as a state machine — draft → reviewed → locked registers produce immutable payslips that nothing retroactively rewrites.
Biometric reconciliation engine: 4-punch sorting, worked-hours math, locked-period guards, and manual-adjustment protection so device sync never clobbers clerk-verified data.
Law-aware deduction scheduling — SSS / PhilHealth / Pag-IBIG contributions and loans land in their correct week-of-month; snapshotting freezes rates & shift boundaries at punch time.
Discrepancy gating blocks approve/lock/print/export until missing clock-outs are resolved — flagged and paid conservatively as half-days in the meantime.
True multi-tenancy via BelongsToTenant + global TenantScope, Super Admin tenant switching, and white-label theming that regenerates contrast via CSS color-mix().
Self-hosting compilers: one-click offline installers that register NSSM web/vite/reverb services, plus a Cloudflare tunnel variant for remote support and a NativePHP desktop build.

featured.title: Branch Updater & Biometrics
featured.subtitle: Centralized Branch Office Update & Data-Sync Infrastructure
featured.pitch: Keeps every branch office in sync — delta-syncing legacy FoxPro databases to a central cloud server, pushing application updates to branch PCs, pulling ZKTeco biometric attendance, and giving head office a command-center dashboard over it all.
features: Delta-sync engine — clients post file manifests by size + mtime, the server diffs and streams back only what's missing, then mirrors the full tree to S3 as durable storage.
Dual-source branch recovery: pull archives from the server's live copy or directly from S3 over 8 threads for disaster recovery.
Self-updating distribution loop — manager pushes a zip, branch launcher polls/downloads/extracts/restarts, and a silent Inno Setup package re-registers NSSM services across the fleet.
Headless biometric agent polls ZKTeco hardware, uploads attendance, and listens for remote commands on a WebSocket channel in real time.
Head-office Command Center (CustomTkinter) monitors every branch, pushes updates, triggers force-sync, and exports CSV.
Security discipline — secrets via environment variables or gitignored configs, branch IDs sanitized server-side, and TLS-enforced transport.

featured.title: LEPT Review Hub
featured.subtitle: Local-First AI Teacher's Review App
featured.pitch: A local-first app that records class audio through a virtual microphone, transcribes it with Groq Whisper (Tagalog), and turns transcripts into study notes, flashcards, and quizzes with Gemini — no cloud hosting, no user accounts, fully private.
features: Virtual-mic class recording with automatic 2-minute chunking and background transcription via Groq's whisper-large-v3 in Tagalog.
Pure-PHP chunk splitting to keep WAV uploads under Groq's 25 MB API limit — no heavyweight processing required.
Single Livewire dashboard with tabs for notes, quiz, flashcards, chat, and upload; Gemini generates the study materials.
Background auto-recorder watches Teams/Zoom/Chrome and captures only while a class is running.
100% local — SQLite database, keys from .env, .wav/.env/db gitignored so personal class data never leaves the machine or the repo.
